description: Router agent: classify a document page into one of the 3 fixed types + language.

parts.template:
Classify this document image/text as exactly one of:
- invoice (tax invoice, sales invoice, POS receipt, billing document)
- purchase_order (PO document ordering goods/services)
- delivery_note (shipping/delivery document accompanying goods)
- unsupported (anything else: specification tables, Grade Substitutions
  charts, reference sheets, blank forms, or pages without monetary
  business content — never force one of the three types onto them)

Also detect the primary language by script majority (Latin-script
business text is en; Thai script is th), or other.
Answer from the document content only — the filename is a weak hint.
Return confidence 0.0-1.0 and a one-sentence reason. When guessing,
keep confidence below 0.5.

changelog: v1: initial registry import — content byte-identical to the inline _ROUTER_PROMPT of the prompts-v4-canonical-judge era.
